description: This is a Java test class named HttpUtilsTest that verifies the functionality of the HttpUtils utility class related to extracting time-to-live and disconnect timing information from HTTP requests in an Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: HttpUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HttpUtils, testing extraction of time till disconnect and time-to-live values from RoutingContext and HttpServerRequest.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock RoutingContext and HttpServerRequest objects before each test.

methods.name: testGetTimeTillDisconnectUsesHeader
methods.description: Tests that getTimeTillDisconnect correctly retrieves the value from the request header.

methods.name: testGetTimeTillDisconnectUsesQueryParam
methods.description: Tests that getTimeTillDisconnect retrieves the value from a query parameter if the header is absent.

methods.name: testGetTimeTillDisconnectReturnsNullIfNotSpecified
methods.description: Ensures getTimeTillDisconnect returns null when neither header nor query parameter is provided.

methods.name: testGetTimeToLiveUsesHeader
methods.description: Verifies getTimeToLive extracts the TTL value from the header.

methods.name: testGetTimeToLiveUsesQueryParam
methods.description: Verifies getTimeToLive extracts the TTL value from the query parameter.

methods.name: testGetTimeToLiverReturnsNullIfNotSpecified
methods.description: Ensures getTimeToLive returns null if neither header nor query parameter is provided.
